changes: Audio now hands off cleanly when a cartridge starts, so the end of the GBC startup jingle is no longer clipped and short underruns recover more quietly.
The options drawers now use one consistent centre-grown green selection bar, with even spacing around LCD and sound sliders.
The one-file offline library, artwork, supplied legal BIOS profiles, browser saves, snapshots, and cartridge-switch protections stay together in this build.
In a nine-trial core-only smoke run, median throughput was 792.70 FPS on the DMG Tetris case and 665.75 FPS on the CGB Tetris DX case; actual game speed is unchanged.
The controlled conformance harness reports 60/76 for GAMEBOY LAB and 65/76 for SameBoy 1.0.3 with failures, timeouts, crashes, and unsupported cases separated instead of hidden.
The full verification suite is green (99/99), with 70/70 applicable Mooneye checks and no conformance timeouts.
